notes.en: The view defaults to DoubleClicked | EditKeyPressed (F2). Adapters can override per index. Buttons and external actions call view->edit(index). The model item must have ItemIsEditable and ItemIsEnabled.

examples.zh: 以下重载放在已有的行/单元格 adapter 类中：第 0 列单击编辑，第 1 列沿用视图设置，其余列只允许显式 edit(index)。模型编辑权限仍然有效。
examples.en: Place this override inside an existing row/cell adapter: column 0 edits on a single click, column 1 inherits view settings, and other columns require explicit edit(index). Model editing permissions still apply.

functions.zh: 返回 true 表示适配器接管编辑（例如 Popup），返回 false 进入 createEditor。context 提供 viewport/view/global 矩形；业务结束调用 finish，不会自动写模型。
functions.en: Return true to handle editing in the adapter, such as a Popup, or false to use createEditor. The context supplies viewport/view/global rectangles. Call finish when done; it does not write model data.

functions.zh: 取消适配器接管的编辑请求；在此关闭 Popup，不提交数据。索引可能失效，控件销毁应延迟到当前事件结束。
functions.en: Cancel an adapter-owned edit request. Close the Popup without committing. The index may be invalid; defer widget destruction until the current event returns.

functions.zh: 在给定裁剪宿主下创建覆盖编辑控件；返回 nullptr 表示不创建。组合编辑器应将焦点代理指向实际输入控件。
functions.en: Create an overlay editor under the supplied clipping host; return nullptr to decline. Composite editors should set a focus proxy to the actual input.

examples.zh: 以下三个方法放在用于整数项的现有 adapter 类内，需包含 QSpinBox 和 QAbstractItemModel。原值保存于 Qt::UserRole + 1；bindWidget()/bindCellWidget() 从同一 role 读取并格式化。若混用不同编辑器，应先按列或类型分支，再进行 static_cast。
examples.en: Place these three methods inside an existing adapter for integer items; include QSpinBox and QAbstractItemModel. Raw values live in Qt::UserRole + 1; bindWidget()/bindCellWidget() reads that same role for display formatting. When mixing editor types, branch by column/type before static_cast.

functions.zh: 将模型值载入编辑器。默认读取 EditRole 并写入 Qt USER 属性；自定义 role 时与 commitEditorData 成对重载。
functions.en: Load model data into the editor. The default reads EditRole into the Qt USER property; override together with commitEditorData for a custom role.

defaults.zh: 无固定初始文本；默认读取 context.index 的 Qt::EditRole，写入 editor 的 USER 属性。
defaults.en: No fixed initial text; the default reads Qt::EditRole from context.index and writes it to the editor USER property.

examples.zh: 以下三个方法放在用于整数项的现有 adapter 类内，需包含 QSpinBox 和 QAbstractItemModel。原值保存于 Qt::UserRole + 1；bindWidget()/bindCellWidget() 从同一 role 读取并格式化。若混用不同编辑器，应先按列或类型分支，再进行 static_cast。
examples.en: Place these three methods inside an existing adapter for integer items; include QSpinBox and QAbstractItemModel. Raw values live in Qt::UserRole + 1; bindWidget()/bindCellWidget() reads that same role for display formatting. When mixing editor types, branch by column/type before static_cast.

functions.en: Update overlay editor geometry; the default uses the full cell rectangle in parent coordinates. For trees, inset by context.indentationWidth / branchWidth, clamped to rect width.

functions.signature: virtual bool commitEditorData(QWidget *editor, QAbstractItemModel *model, const ItemBindingContext &context);

functions.en: Write editor data to the model; the default writes the Qt USER property to EditRole. Return false to keep editing, for example after validation failure.

functions.en: Check whether the pane or specified row/column belongs to a frozen region.

functions.en: Construct ColumnHost with the parent, model or layout arguments in this overload. QObject/QWidget parent arguments follow Qt parent-child lifetime rules.

functions.en: Lay out row children using TableRowLayoutContext, respecting pane clipping and visual column order. ColumnHost lets the framework position columns.

functions.zh: 销毁 CellWidgetAdapter 并释放其拥有的资源；不在析构回调中继续使用该对象。

functions.zh: 返回复用类型标识。只有结构兼容的控件才应使用同一个类型值。
functions.en: Return the recycling type identifier. Only structurally compatible widgets should share a type.

functions.zh: 在给定 parent 下创建指定类型的控件。只构造界面；每次项目数据由 bind 回调填充。
functions.en: Create a widget of the requested type under parent. Construct the UI here; populate item data in bind callbacks.

functions.zh: 将当前模型索引或绑定上下文的数据写入复用控件。每次绑定应覆盖旧内容，避免残留；不要重复连接同一信号。
functions.en: Populate a reusable widget from the current index or binding context. Replace stale content on every bind and avoid duplicate signal connections.

functions.zh: 将当前模型索引或绑定上下文的数据写入复用控件。每次绑定应覆盖旧内容，避免残留；不要重复连接同一信号。
functions.en: Populate a reusable widget from the current index or binding context. Replace stale content on every bind and avoid duplicate signal connections.

functions.zh: 接收框架计算后的 hover、选中和动画进度；据此更新按钮等子控件，通常无需重复绘制框架状态背景。
functions.en: Receive framework-computed hover, selection and animation progress. Update child controls from this state; ordinarily do not duplicate framework background painting.

functions.zh: 接收框架计算后的 hover、选中和动画进度；据此更新按钮等子控件，通常无需重复绘制框架状态背景。
functions.en: Receive framework-computed hover, selection and animation progress. Update child controls from this state; ordinarily do not duplicate framework background painting.

functions.zh: 解除控件与旧项目的业务关联，取消旧请求并清理临时状态，供下次复用。

functions.zh: 解除控件与旧项目的业务关联，取消旧请求并清理临时状态，供下次复用。
functions.en: Detach the widget from its old item, cancel obsolete work and clear transient state before reuse.

functions.zh: 构造 TreeVisibilityIndex；按此重载传入父对象、模型或布局参数。带 parent 的 QObject/QWidget 遵循 Qt 父子生命周期。

functions.en: Check visibility under the current expansion hierarchy; this does not imply on-screen materialization.

functions.zh: 返回指定树节点的层级深度。
functions.en: Return the depth of the specified tree node.

functions.en: Expand the specified node. Descendant visibility also depends on ancestor expansion. Views with animation enabled drive real widget layout.

functions.zh: 收起指定节点。 子孙可见性由祖先展开状态共同决定；视图启用动画时由框架驱动真实控件布局。
functions.en: Collapse the specified node. Descendant visibility also depends on ancestor expansion. Views with animation enabled drive real widget layout.

functions.zh: 判断指定节点或当前 branch 状态是否展开。

functions.zh: 返回已展开节点数。
functions.en: Return the expanded node count.

functions.zh: 判断指定索引、行或位置是否在当前范围内。
functions.en: Check whether an index, row or position is contained in this range.

functions.zh: 返回布局、索引或范围中的项目数量。
functions.en: Return the item count in the layout, index or range.

examples.zh: 流式网格按 16:9 宽高比布局。view 为已设置模型和 adapter 的 VirtualFlowTableView；宽高比为宽/高，需同时切换 AspectRatio 模式，不能使用继承的 setUniformItemHeight() 替代。
examples.en: Lay out a flow grid at a 16:9 aspect ratio. view is a VirtualFlowTableView with a model and adapter. The ratio is width/height; also select AspectRatio mode rather than using inherited setUniformItemHeight().

functions.zh: 设置行间距。

functions.zh: 设置间距中心或两侧分割线模式。
functions.en: Set the grid line placement at spacing centers or edges.

notes.zh: 默认 SpacingCenter：在间距中心绘制，交叉线始终穿过间距，且外侧补半间距；零间距时不重复画线。SpacingEdges 在间距两侧绘制，只有这个模式允许控制是否穿过交叉间距。是否穿过表头使用单独开关。
notes.en: SpacingCenter is the default: lines run through gap centers, cross gaps unconditionally, and use outer half-gaps; zero spacing does not duplicate lines. SpacingEdges draws both gap edges and alone allows disabling crossings through perpendicular gaps. Header crossings have independent switches.

defaults.zh: GridLinePlacement::SpacingCenter；无间距时回退到项边界，不重复绘制。
defaults.en: GridLinePlacement::SpacingCenter; without spacing, lines fall back to item boundaries without duplicates.

functions.zh: 返回逻辑列数。
functions.en: Return the logical column count.

functions.zh: 返回布局实际排出的显示行数。
functions.en: Return the number of display rows produced by the layout.

functions.zh: 返回指定逻辑列宽度。
functions.en: Return the width of the specified logical column.

notes.zh: 普通比例拉伸在手动拖动或显式设置列宽后整体取消。FitViewport 是独立模式，让列总宽适配视口，并按拖动边缘在另一侧列中分摊宽度；不要混同于普通 stretch 权重。
notes.en: Ordinary proportional stretching is cleared by manual resizing or explicit column widths. FitViewport is a separate mode that fits total column width to the viewport and distributes a resize across columns on the corresponding side; it is distinct from ordinary stretch weights.

functions.zh: 返回指定逻辑列在视口中的横坐标（考虑窗格滚动）。
functions.en: Return the viewport x coordinate of the logical column, including pane scrolling.

functions.zh: 返回项目在流式排版中的显示行号或列号，与原始模型行号不同。
functions.en: Return the item's display row or column in the flow layout, distinct from its original model row.

functions.zh: 返回项目在流式排版中的显示行号或列号，与原始模型行号不同。
functions.en: Return the item's display row or column in the flow layout, distinct from its original model row.

functions.zh: 对应布局重新计算后发出，通知业务更新依赖排版的内容。
functions.en: Emitted when the corresponding layout changes so clients can update layout-dependent content.

functions.signature: explicit VirtualHeaderView(Qt::Orientation orientation = Qt::Horizontal, QWidget *parent = nullptr);
functions.zh: 构造 VirtualHeaderView；按此重载传入父对象、模型或布局参数。带 parent 的 QObject/QWidget 遵循 Qt 父子生命周期。
functions.en: Construct VirtualHeaderView with the parent, model or layout arguments in this overload. QObject/QWidget parent arguments follow Qt parent-child lifetime rules.

functions.zh: 销毁 VirtualHeaderView 并释放其拥有的资源；不在析构回调中继续使用该对象。
functions.en: Destroy VirtualHeaderView and release its owned resources; do not keep using the object during destruction callbacks.

SpacingEdges draws both gap edges and alone allows disabling crossings through perpendicular gaps. Header crossings have independent switches.

functions.zh: 设置项目控件适配器。
functions.en: Set the item widget adapter.

notes.zh: takeOwnership 默认为 false，未转移所有权时调用方须保证 adapter 存活。RowWidgets 使用 TableWidgetAdapter，CellWidgets 使用 CellWidgetAdapter。创建控件和绑定数据应分离；复用时清除旧业务关联。
notes.en: takeOwnership defaults to false; the caller must keep a non-owned adapter alive. RowWidgets uses TableWidgetAdapter and CellWidgets uses CellWidgetAdapter. Separate widget creation from binding and clear obsolete business associations on reuse.

defaults.zh: 内置 LabelHeaderAdapter，由表头拥有。替换 adapter 的 takeOwnership 参数默认 false。

functions.zh: 返回项目控件适配器。

functions.zh: 设置按内容固定视图高度的开关。
functions.en: Set the content-based fixed view height setting.

notes.zh: 虚拟视图默认关闭，WrapWidget 默认开启。启用后按内容设置固定高度，父布局不再把它压缩；上限为 0 时不限高。高度包含边距、间距、表头和实际边框等占位。使用 setAutoHeightMaximumHeight 控制上限，不要同时用 QWidget 高度约束干预；关闭后恢复原约束。内部无滚动范围时，滚轮交给外层。
notes.en: Disabled by default on virtual views and enabled on WrapWidget. When enabled, content sets a fixed height that the parent layout cannot compress; a maximum of 0 is unlimited. The height includes margins, gaps, headers and occupied frame space. Use setAutoHeightMaximumHeight rather than competing QWidget height constraints; disabling restores prior constraints. Wheel input propagates outward when there is no internal scroll range.

examples.zh: 在垂直布局中按内容高度显示表格，最多 240 逻辑像素。view 为已设置 model 和 adapter 的 VirtualTableView；框架计算表头、内容和边框总高。不要再对同一控件调用 QWidget::setFixedHeight()。无内部滚动范围时滚轮会转交外层。
examples.en: Size a table to its content in a vertical layout, capped at 240 logical pixels. view is a VirtualTableView with a model and adapter. The framework includes header, content and border heights. Do not also call QWidget::setFixedHeight() on this view. Wheel events pass outward when there is no internal scroll range.

functions.zh: 设置hover 和选中缓动曲线。
functions.en: Set the hover and selection easing curve.

notes.zh: 默认时长 180ms，曲线 OutCubic。adapter 应使用 visualState 中的进度，以保持子控件与框架背景同步。原生拖动期间普通 hover 暂停并清空，结束后按当前鼠标位置恢复。
notes.en: Defaults to 180 ms with OutCubic easing. Adapters should use visualState progress to stay synchronized with framework backgrounds. Native dragging suspends and clears ordinary hover, restoring it at the current cursor position afterward.

functions.zh: 返回hover 和选中缓动曲线。
functions.en: Return the hover and selection easing curve.

notes.zh: 默认时长 180ms，曲线 OutCubic。adapter 应使用 visualState 中的进度，以保持子控件与框架背景同步。原生拖动期间普通 hover 暂停并清空，结束后按当前鼠标位置恢复。
notes.en: Defaults to 180 ms with OutCubic easing. Adapters should use visualState progress to stay synchronized with framework backgrounds. Native dragging suspends and clears ordinary hover, restoring it at the current cursor position afterward.

functions.zh: 返回当前项索引（区别于所有选中项）。
functions.en: Return the current index, distinct from the full selection.

defaults.zh: 无效 QModelIndex；初始没有 current 项，此接口修改当前项而非配置常量。
defaults.en: Invalid QModelIndex; there is initially no current item. This updates current state rather than a configuration constant.

functions.zh: 设置当前项索引（区别于所有选中项）。
functions.en: Set the current index, distinct from the full selection.

defaults.zh: 无效 QModelIndex；初始没有 current 项，此接口修改当前项而非配置常量。
defaults.en: Invalid QModelIndex; there is initially no current item. This updates current state rather than a configuration constant.

functions.zh: 激活指定索引，走视图的项目激活流程。
functions.en: Activate the specified index through the view item activation path.

functions.zh: 设置单选、多选、扩展或禁止用户选择模式。
functions.en: Set the single, multiple, extended or no-user-selection mode.

notes.zh: 默认 ExtendedSelection + SelectRows。SelectRows 同时让 hover/selected 按行显示；SelectItems 按 cell 显示。SelectionMode 约束用户手势；程序批量选择使用 selectionModel()->select(QItemSelection, flags)，不要循环 setCurrentIndex。
notes.en: Defaults to ExtendedSelection + SelectRows. SelectRows highlights hover/selection by row; SelectItems highlights cells. SelectionMode constrains user gestures. For programmatic ranges use selectionModel()->select(QItemSelection, flags), not repeated setCurrentIndex calls.

examples.zh: 按单元格选择，并仅在内容区域绘制状态背景。view 为 VirtualTableView；ExtendedSelection 支持 Ctrl/Shift，SelectItems 同时决定 hover/selection 的单元格范围。关闭表头状态同步不影响内容选择。
examples.en: Select cells and paint state backgrounds only in the body. view is a VirtualTableView. ExtendedSelection supports Ctrl/Shift, while SelectItems sets the cell extent for both hover and selection. Disabling header state painting does not disable body selection.

functions.zh: 返回单选、多选、扩展或禁止用户选择模式。
functions.en: Return the single, multiple, extended or no-user-selection mode.

notes.zh: 默认 ExtendedSelection + SelectRows。SelectRows 同时让 hover/selected 按行显示；SelectItems 按 cell 显示。SelectionMode 约束用户手势；程序批量选择使用 selectionModel()->select(QItemSelection, flags)，不要循环 setCurrentIndex。
notes.en: Defaults to ExtendedSelection + SelectRows. SelectRows highlights hover/selection by row; SelectItems highlights cells. SelectionMode constrains user gestures. For programmatic ranges use selectionModel()->select(QItemSelection, flags), not repeated setCurrentIndex calls.

functions.zh: 设置按行或单元格选择行为。
functions.en: Set the row or cell selection behavior.

notes.zh: 默认 ExtendedSelection + SelectRows。SelectRows 同时让 hover/selected 按行显示；SelectItems 按 cell 显示。SelectionMode 约束用户手势；程序批量选择使用 selectionModel()->select(QItemSelection, flags)，不要循环 setCurrentIndex。

examples.zh: 按单元格选择，并仅在内容区域绘制状态背景。view 为 VirtualTableView；ExtendedSelection 支持 Ctrl/Shift，SelectItems 同时决定 hover/selection 的单元格范围。关闭表头状态同步不影响内容选择。
examples.en: Select cells and paint state backgrounds only in the body. view is a VirtualTableView. ExtendedSelection supports Ctrl/Shift, while SelectItems sets the cell extent for both hover and selection. Disabling header state painting does not disable body selection.

functions.zh: 返回按行或单元格选择行为。
functions.en: Return the row or cell selection behavior.

notes.zh: 默认 ExtendedSelection + SelectRows。SelectRows 同时让 hover/selected 按行显示；SelectItems 按 cell 显示。SelectionMode 约束用户手势；程序批量选择使用 selectionModel()->select(QItemSelection, flags)，不要循环 setCurrentIndex。
notes.en: Defaults to ExtendedSelection + SelectRows. SelectRows highlights hover/selection by row; SelectItems highlights cells. SelectionMode constrains user gestures. For programmatic ranges use selectionModel()->select(QItemSelection, flags), not repeated setCurrentIndex calls.

functions.zh: 设置项目拖动开关。
functions.en: Set the item dragging setting.

examples.zh: 为表格启用自动起拖和虚线插入指示器。view 为 VirtualTableView；模型必须提供拖放 flags、MIME 与移动/放下实现。这里不启用 setMoveRemovesSourceRows：若 dropMimeData() 自己移动原项，再删除源行会重复移除。
examples.en: Enable automatic table dragging with a dashed insertion indicator. view is a VirtualTableView; its model must implement drag/drop flags, MIME and move/drop behavior. setMoveRemovesSourceRows is intentionally left disabled: if dropMimeData() already moves the originals, removing source rows again would delete them twice.

functions.zh: 返回项目拖动开关。
functions.en: Return the item dragging setting.

functions.zh: 设置自动或手动起拖模式。
functions.en: Set the automatic or manual drag-start mode.

examples.zh: 为表格启用自动起拖和虚线插入指示器。view 为 VirtualTableView；模型必须提供拖放 flags、MIME 与移动/放下实现。这里不启用 setMoveRemovesSourceRows：若 dropMimeData() 自己移动原项，再删除源行会重复移除。
examples.en: Enable automatic table dragging with a dashed insertion indicator. view is a VirtualTableView; its model must implement drag/drop flags, MIME and move/drop behavior. setMoveRemovesSourceRows is intentionally left disabled: if dropMimeData() already moves the originals, removing source rows again would delete them twice.

functions.zh: 返回自动或手动起拖模式。
functions.en: Return the automatic or manual drag-start mode.

functions.zh: 检查给定索引是否满足当前拖动条件；可在显示拖动手柄或发起操作前查询。
functions.en: Check whether the index meets current drag-start requirements, for example before enabling a drag handle.

functions.zh: 显式启动原生拖动；框架管理预览、普通 hover 暂停及结束恢复。行选择预览整行，单元格选择预览目标 cell；模型负责 MIME 和落点合法性。
functions.en: Start a native drag explicitly. The framework manages preview, ordinary hover suspension and restoration. Row selection previews a row; cell selection previews a cell. The model controls MIME data and drop legality.

notes.zh: 此重载使用当前选择或 index 生成默认预览；预览锚定匹配的鼠标按下位置，没有匹配事件时使用当前鼠标位置。 返回实际 Qt::DropAction；未拖动、取消或无效落点返回 IgnoreAction。
notes.en: This overload generates the default preview from the current selection or index, anchored at the matching mouse press or the current cursor when no press matches. Returns the actual Qt::DropAction, or IgnoreAction when no drag completes.

functions.zh: 显式启动原生拖动；框架管理预览、普通 hover 暂停及结束恢复。行选择预览整行，单元格选择预览目标 cell；模型负责 MIME 和落点合法性。
functions.en: Start a native drag explicitly. The framework manages preview, ordinary hover suspension and restoration. Row selection previews a row; cell selection previews a cell. The model controls MIME data and drop legality.

notes.zh: 此重载用 DragOptions 覆盖截图控件或截图区域。显式控件配空矩形时截取整个控件；源索引仍用于 MIME 数据和屏外保留。 返回实际 Qt::DropAction；未拖动、取消或无效落点返回 IgnoreAction。
notes.en: This overload uses DragOptions to override the captured widget or rectangle. An explicit widget with an empty rectangle captures the entire widget; the source index still controls MIME data and pinning. Returns the actual Qt::DropAction, or IgnoreAction when no drag completes.

functions.zh: 设置拖放指示器可见性。
functions.en: Set the drop indicator visibility.

functions.zh: 返回拖放指示器可见性。
functions.en: Return the drop indicator visibility.

functions.zh: 设置拖放指示器颜色。
functions.en: Set the drop indicator color.

functions.zh: 返回拖放指示器颜色。
functions.en: Return the drop indicator color.

functions.zh: 设置拖放指示器线宽。
functions.en: Set the drop indicator width.

functions.zh: 返回拖放指示器线宽。
functions.en: Return the drop indicator width.

functions.zh: 设置拖放指示器线型。
functions.en: Set the drop indicator pen style.

examples.zh: 为表格启用自动起拖和虚线插入指示器。view 为 VirtualTableView；模型必须提供拖放 flags、MIME 与移动/放下实现。这里不启用 setMoveRemovesSourceRows：若 dropMimeData() 自己移动原项，再删除源行会重复移除。
examples.en: Enable automatic table dragging with a dashed insertion indicator. view is a VirtualTableView; its model must implement drag/drop flags, MIME and move/drop behavior. setMoveRemovesSourceRows is intentionally left disabled: if dropMimeData() already moves the originals, removing source rows again would delete them twice.

functions.zh: 返回拖放指示器线型。
functions.en: Return the drop indicator pen style.

functions.zh: 设置默认拖放动作。
functions.en: Set the default drop action.

examples.zh: 为表格启用自动起拖和虚线插入指示器。view 为 VirtualTableView；模型必须提供拖放 flags、MIME 与移动/放下实现。这里不启用 setMoveRemovesSourceRows：若 dropMimeData() 自己移动原项，再删除源行会重复移除。
examples.en: Enable automatic table dragging with a dashed insertion indicator. view is a VirtualTableView; its model must implement drag/drop flags, MIME and move/drop behavior. setMoveRemovesSourceRows is intentionally left disabled: if dropMimeData() already moves the originals, removing source rows again would delete them twice.

functions.zh: 返回默认拖放动作。
functions.en: Return the default drop action.

functions.zh: 设置成功移动后框架删除源行开关。
functions.en: Set the framework source row removal after a successful move.

notes.zh: 用于模型 dropMimeData 插入副本但未自行删除源行的 MoveAction。若模型已通过 moveRows 或 dropMimeData 完成移动，不应重复启用源行删除。框架删除源行时会尝试继承源项选择状态。
notes.en: Use for MoveAction when dropMimeData inserts a copy without removing source rows. Do not duplicate source removal if the model already moves rows in moveRows or dropMimeData. Framework-managed removal attempts to preserve source selection.

functions.zh: 返回成功移动后框架删除源行开关。
functions.en: Return the framework source row removal after a successful move.

notes.zh: 用于模型 dropMimeData 插入副本但未自行删除源行的 MoveAction。若模型已通过 moveRows 或 dropMimeData 完成移动，不应重复启用源行删除。框架删除源行时会尝试继承源项选择状态。
notes.en: Use for MoveAction when dropMimeData inserts a copy without removing source rows. Do not duplicate source removal if the model already moves rows in moveRows or dropMimeData. Framework-managed removal attempts to preserve source selection.

functions.zh: 设置允许的拖放动作集合。
functions.en: Set the allowed drag-and-drop actions.

defaults.zh: Qt::IgnoreAction；从模型 supportedDragActions() / supportedDropActions() 推导，非禁用所有操作。
defaults.en: Qt::IgnoreAction; derive actions from model supportedDragActions() / supportedDropActions(), rather than disabling all actions.

functions.zh: 返回允许的拖放动作集合。
functions.en: Return the allowed drag-and-drop actions.

defaults.zh: Qt::IgnoreAction；从模型 supportedDragActions() / supportedDropActions() 推导，非禁用所有操作。
defaults.en: Qt::IgnoreAction; derive actions from model supportedDragActions() / supportedDropActions(), rather than disabling all actions.

functions.zh: 按视口坐标计算拖放目标，包含目标索引、插入位置或层级信息。
functions.en: Resolve a viewport position to a drop target, including its index, insertion position or hierarchy.

functions.zh: 返回当前拖放反馈矩形，坐标属于视口。
functions.en: Return the current drop feedback rectangle in viewport coordinates.

functions.zh: 返回当前拖放指示器的绘制样式。
functions.en: Return the current drop indicator drawing style.

functions.signature: virtual void setAdapter(WidgetAdapter *adapter, bool takeOwnership = false);
functions.zh: 设置项目控件适配器。
functions.en: Set the item widget adapter.

notes.zh: takeOwnership 默认为 false，未转移所有权时调用方须保证 adapter 存活。RowWidgets 使用 TableWidgetAdapter，CellWidgets 使用 CellWidgetAdapter。创建控件和绑定数据应分离；复用时清除旧业务关联。
notes.en: takeOwnership defaults to false; the caller must keep a non-owned adapter alive. RowWidgets uses TableWidgetAdapter and CellWidgets uses CellWidgetAdapter. Separate widget creation from binding and clear obsolete business associations on reuse.

defaults.zh: nullptr；初始没有业务 adapter。takeOwnership 参数默认 false。
defaults.en: nullptr; no application adapter is installed. The takeOwnership argument defaults to false.

functions.zh: 返回项目控件适配器。
functions.en: Return the item widget adapter.

notes.zh: takeOwnership 默认为 false，未转移所有权时调用方须保证 adapter 存活。RowWidgets 使用 TableWidgetAdapter，CellWidgets 使用 CellWidgetAdapter。创建控件和绑定数据应分离；复用时清除旧业务关联。
notes.en: takeOwnership defaults to false; the caller must keep a non-owned adapter alive. RowWidgets uses TableWidgetAdapter and CellWidgets uses CellWidgetAdapter. Separate widget creation from binding and clear obsolete business associations on reuse.

defaults.zh: nullptr；初始没有业务 adapter。takeOwnership 参数默认 false。
defaults.en: nullptr; no application adapter is installed. The takeOwnership argument defaults to false.

functions.zh: 返回视图使用的控件回收器。
functions.en: Return the widget recycler used by the view.

functions.zh: 设置进入编辑的交互触发条件。
functions.en: Set the interaction triggers that start editing.

notes.zh: 视图默认 DoubleClicked | EditKeyPressed（F2）。adapter 可按 index 覆盖；按钮或外部操作直接调用 view->edit(index)。模型需设置 ItemIsEditable 和 ItemIsEnabled。
notes.en: The view defaults to DoubleClicked | EditKeyPressed (F2). Adapters can override per index. Buttons and external actions call view->edit(index). The model item must have ItemIsEditable and ItemIsEnabled.

examples.zh: view 已绑定支持 createEditor() 的 adapter，index 是其模型的有效索引，且 flags 包含 ItemIsEnabled / ItemIsEditable。自动手势与显式 edit() 相互独立；行内按钮处理器中同样调用 edit(index)。
examples.en: view has an adapter implementing createEditor(); index is valid in its model and has ItemIsEnabled / ItemIsEditable flags. Automatic gestures and explicit edit() are independent; an inline button handler can also call edit(index).

functions.zh: 返回进入编辑的交互触发条件。
functions.en: Return the interaction triggers that start editing.

notes.zh: 视图默认 DoubleClicked | EditKeyPressed（F2）。adapter 可按 index 覆盖；按钮或外部操作直接调用 view->edit(index)。模型需设置 ItemIsEditable 和 ItemIsEnabled。
notes.en: The view defaults to DoubleClicked | EditKeyPressed (F2). Adapters can override per index. Buttons and external actions call view->edit(index). The model item must have ItemIsEditable and ItemIsEnabled.

functions.zh: 请求编辑指定索引，独立于自动触发配置。模型必须允许编辑且启用项目；先走 adapter.editRequest，再创建覆盖编辑器。
functions.en: Request editing for the index independently of automatic triggers. The model item must be enabled and editable. adapter.editRequest runs before overlay creation.

examples.zh: view 已绑定支持 createEditor() 的 adapter，index 是其模型的有效索引，且 flags 包含 ItemIsEnabled / ItemIsEditable。自动手势与显式 edit() 相互独立；行内按钮处理器中同样调用 edit(index)。
examples.en: view has an adapter implementing createEditor(); index is valid in its model and has ItemIsEnabled / ItemIsEditable flags. Automatic gestures and explicit edit() are independent; an inline button handler can also call edit(index).

functions.zh: 提交当前覆盖编辑器内容；提交失败时保留编辑器。
functions.en: Commit the active overlay editor, keeping it open if committing fails.

notes.zh: 成功时提交并关闭覆盖编辑器；adapter 接管的 Popup 由业务提交，本函数返回 false。
notes.en: Success commits and closes the overlay. Adapter-owned Popups handle their own submission; this method returns false for them.

functions.zh: 取消当前编辑，不提交草稿；也会通过 cancelEditRequest 取消适配器接管的 Popup。
functions.en: Cancel the current edit without committing the draft, including adapter-owned Popups through cancelEditRequest.

functions.zh: 返回当前编辑会话对应索引；无会话时返回无效索引。
functions.en: Return the active edit session index, or an invalid index when no session exists.

functions.zh: 返回当前覆盖编辑器；没有覆盖编辑器或由 Popup 接管时可能为空。
functions.en: Return the active overlay editor; it may be null when no overlay exists or a Popup owns editing.

functions.zh: 设置绑定上下文 rowData 读取的模型 role。
functions.en: Set the model role read into binding context rowData.

notes.zh: cell 从所在行的列 0 读取该 role。负数禁用 rowData 读取；修改 role 会重新绑定已物化控件。
notes.en: Cells read this role from column 0 of their row. A negative role disables rowData reads; changing the role rebinds materialized widgets.

functions.zh: 返回绑定上下文 rowData 读取的模型 role。
functions.en: Return the model role read into binding context rowData.

notes.zh: cell 从所在行的列 0 读取该 role。负数禁用 rowData 读取；修改 role 会重新绑定已物化控件。
notes.en: Cells read this role from column 0 of their row. A negative role disables rowData reads; changing the role rebinds materialized widgets.

functions.zh: 设置可见范围前后额外物化项数；减少它能降低控件数量，增大它可减少滚动边缘临时创建。
functions.en: Set item overscan before and after the visible range. Smaller values reduce widget counts; larger values reduce materialization at scroll edges.

functions.zh: 返回可见范围之前或之后额外物化项目数。
functions.en: Return the item overscan before or after the visible range.

functions.zh: 返回可见范围之前或之后额外物化项目数。
functions.en: Return the item overscan before or after the visible range.

functions.zh: 设置行间距。
functions.en: Set the spacing between rows.

examples.zh: 设置间距中心分割线，并在水平表头下添加完整行间距。view 为 VirtualTableView；Horizontal 对应表头下方，Vertical 对应行号条右侧。这里额外表头间距为 rowSpacing() 的 8 像素，不是独立数值。
examples.en: Use centered gap separators and add a full row gap below the horizontal header. view is a VirtualTableView. Horizontal means below the column header; Vertical means right of the row-number strip. The extra header gap is rowSpacing(), 8 pixels here, rather than an independent size.

functions.zh: 返回行间距。
functions.en: Return the spacing between rows.

functions.zh: 设置间距中心或两侧分割线模式。
functions.en: Set the grid line placement at spacing centers or edges.

notes.zh: 默认 SpacingCenter：在间距中心绘制，交叉线始终穿过间距，且外侧补半间距；零间距时不重复画线。SpacingEdges 在间距两侧绘制，只有这个模式允许控制是否穿过交叉间距。是否穿过表头使用单独开关。
notes.en: SpacingCenter is the default: lines run through gap centers, cross gaps unconditionally, and use outer half-gaps; zero spacing does not duplicate lines. SpacingEdges draws both gap edges and alone allows disabling crossings through perpendicular gaps. Header crossings have independent switches.

defaults.zh: GridLinePlacement::SpacingCenter；无间距时回退到项边界，不重复绘制。
defaults.en: GridLinePlacement::SpacingCenter; without spacing, lines fall back to item boundaries without duplicates.

examples.zh: 设置间距中心分割线，并在水平表头下添加完整行间距。view 为 VirtualTableView；Horizontal 对应表头下方，Vertical 对应行号条右侧。这里额外表头间距为 rowSpacing() 的 8 像素，不是独立数值。
examples.en: Use centered gap separators and add a full row gap below the horizontal header. view is a VirtualTableView. Horizontal means below the column header; Vertical means right of the row-number strip. The extra header gap is rowSpacing(), 8 pixels here, rather than an independent size.

functions.zh: 返回间距中心或两侧分割线模式。
functions.en: Return the grid line placement at spacing centers or edges.

notes.zh: 默认 SpacingCenter：在间距中心绘制，交叉线始终穿过间距，且外侧补半间距；零间距时不重复画线。SpacingEdges 在间距两侧绘制，只有这个模式允许控制是否穿过交叉间距。是否穿过表头使用单独开关。
notes.en: SpacingCenter is the default: lines run through gap centers, cross gaps unconditionally, and use outer half-gaps; zero spacing does not duplicate lines. SpacingEdges draws both gap edges and alone allows disabling crossings through perpendicular gaps. Header crossings have independent switches.

defaults.zh: GridLinePlacement::SpacingCenter；无间距时回退到项边界，不重复绘制。
defaults.en: GridLinePlacement::SpacingCenter; without spacing, lines fall back to item boundaries without duplicates.

functions.zh: 设置贴近底边框自动隐藏末行线开关。
functions.en: Set the automatic trailing row line hiding next to the bottom frame.

notes.zh: 默认自动隐藏，避免末行线贴合底边框叠成双线。关闭后始终按分割线规则绘制末行边界；边距、实际内容底部及滚动范围仍决定其可见位置。
notes.en: Automatic hiding is enabled by default to avoid doubling a line next to the bottom frame. Disable it to retain the trailing boundary according to grid rules; margins, the actual content bottom and scroll range still determine visibility.

examples.zh: 在垂直布局中按内容高度显示表格，最多 240 逻辑像素。view 为已设置 model 和 adapter 的 VirtualTableView；框架计算表头、内容和边框总高。不要再对同一控件调用 QWidget::setFixedHeight()。无内部滚动范围时滚轮会转交外层。
examples.en: Size a table to its content in a vertical layout, capped at 240 logical pixels. view is a VirtualTableView with a model and adapter. The framework includes header, content and border heights. Do not also call QWidget::setFixedHeight() on this view. Wheel events pass outward when there is no internal scroll range.

functions.zh: 返回贴近底边框自动隐藏末行线开关。
functions.en: Return the automatic trailing row line hiding next to the bottom frame.

notes.zh: 默认自动隐藏，避免末行线贴合底边框叠成双线。关闭后始终按分割线规则绘制末行边界；边距、实际内容底部及滚动范围仍决定其可见位置。
notes.en: Automatic hiding is enabled by default to avoid doubling a line next to the bottom frame. Disable it to retain the trailing boundary according to grid rules; margins, the actual content bottom and scroll range still determine visibility.

functions.zh: 设置内容或表头间距背景颜色。
functions.en: Set the content or header gap background color.

defaults.zh: 无效 QColor；未指定间距色，随内容背景绘制，默认 QPalette::Base。
defaults.en: Invalid QColor; gaps follow the content background, QPalette::Base by default.

functions.zh: 返回内容或表头间距背景颜色。
functions.en: Return the content or header gap background color.

defaults.zh: 无效 QColor；未指定间距色，随内容背景绘制，默认 QPalette::Base。
defaults.en: Invalid QColor; gaps follow the content background, QPalette::Base by default.

functions.zh: 提供间距控件工厂以定制间距区域。优先只设置背景颜色，确实需要交互或复杂内容时再创建间距控件。
functions.en: Supply a spacing-widget factory to customize gaps. Prefer a background color alone unless the gap needs interaction or complex content.

defaults.zh: 工厂和 binder 均为空；不创建自定义间距控件。
defaults.en: Empty factory and binder; no custom gap widgets.

functions.signature: void scrollTo(const QModelIndex &index, ScrollHint hint = EnsureVisible);
functions.zh: 滚动到指定项目，按定位提示决定靠近顶部、底部或仅确保可见。
functions.en: Scroll to an item using the positioning hint, such as top, bottom or ensure-visible.

functions.signature: void setItemPinned(const QModelIndex &index, bool pinned = true);
functions.zh: 保留或解除保留屏外项目控件；尚未物化的项目会立即物化。maxPinnedItems 是诊断软上限，不会自动回收已保留控件，业务需要主动解除保留。
functions.en: Pin or unpin an offscreen item widget, materializing it immediately if needed. maxPinnedItems is a diagnostic soft limit and never automatically recycles pinned widgets; the application must unpin them.

defaults.en: false; no items are explicitly pinned.

functions.zh: 返回指定项目屏外保留状态。
functions.en: Return the offscreen pinning state of the specified item.

notes.zh: 包括原生拖动期间的临时保留；显式保留独立于该临时状态。
notes.en: Includes temporary pinning during native dragging; explicit pins are independent of that temporary state.

functions.zh: 保留或解除保留屏外项目控件；尚未物化的项目会立即物化。maxPinnedItems 是诊断软上限，不会自动回收已保留控件，业务需要主动解除保留。
functions.en: Pin or unpin an offscreen item widget, materializing it immediately if needed. maxPinnedItems is a diagnostic soft limit and never automatically recycles pinned widgets; the application must unpin them.

functions.zh: 保留或解除保留屏外项目控件；尚未物化的项目会立即物化。maxPinnedItems 是诊断软上限，不会自动回收已保留控件，业务需要主动解除保留。
functions.en: Pin or unpin an offscreen item widget, materializing it immediately if needed. maxPinnedItems is a diagnostic soft limit and never automatically recycles pinned widgets; the application must unpin them.

functions.zh: 设置屏外保留项目数的诊断软上限；超出仅警告一次，不会强制回收。非正值关闭检查。
functions.en: Set the diagnostic soft limit for pinned items. Exceeding it warns once without forcibly recycling widgets; nonpositive values disable the check.

defaults.en: 0; no limit on explicitly pinned items.

functions.zh: 返回屏外保留项目数的诊断软上限；超出仅警告一次，不会强制回收。非正值关闭检查。
functions.en: Return the diagnostic soft limit for pinned items. Exceeding it warns once without forcibly recycling widgets; nonpositive values disable the check.

defaults.en: 0; no limit on explicitly pinned items.

functions.zh: 返回虚拟化与控件复用统计信息。
functions.en: Return the virtualization and widget recycling statistics.

functions.zh: 设置性能探测开关；需配合 viv.performance 日志分类过滤。
functions.en: Set the performance probe setting; use with viv.performance category filtering.

notes.zh: 诊断按时间窗口聚合，分别统计布局、物化、adapter 回调及绘制等阶段；不同阶段可能包含嵌套时间，不能直接相加。关闭时跳过统计工作。
notes.en: Diagnostics aggregate over time windows and separate layout, materialization, adapter callbacks and painting. Nested stage durations must not be added as independent costs. Disabling skips statistical collection.

functions.zh: 返回性能探测开关；需配合 viv.performance 日志分类过滤。
functions.en: Return the performance probe setting; use with viv.performance category filtering.

notes.zh: 诊断按时间窗口聚合，分别统计布局、物化、adapter 回调及绘制等阶段；不同阶段可能包含嵌套时间，不能直接相加。关闭时跳过统计工作。
notes.en: Diagnostics aggregate over time windows and separate layout, materialization, adapter callbacks and painting. Nested stage durations must not be added as independent costs. Disabling skips statistical collection.

functions.zh: 设置控件生命周期记录开关。
functions.en: Set the widget lifecycle logging setting.

functions.zh: 返回控件生命周期记录开关。
functions.en: Return the widget lifecycle logging setting.

functions.zh: 返回已收集的控件生命周期日志。
functions.en: Return the collected widget lifecycle log.

functions.zh: 清除控件创建、绑定和回收生命周期日志。
functions.en: Clear the widget creation, binding and recycling lifecycle log.

functions.zh: 命中给定坐标对应的项目；视图接口使用视口坐标，布局策略使用布局坐标。空白区域返回无效结果。
functions.en: Hit-test an item at a position. Views use viewport coordinates; layout policies use layout coordinates. Blank space returns an invalid result.

functions.zh: 查询对应项目、单元格、窗格或合并区域的矩形。视图结果为视口坐标；布局策略结果为布局坐标；屏外矩形可超出可见区域。
functions.en: Query the item, cell, pane or span rectangle. View results use viewport coordinates; layout policies use layout coordinates. Offscreen rectangles may extend beyond the visible area.

functions.zh: 判断布局当前是否以项目控件物化数据。
functions.en: Check whether the layout currently materializes item widgets.

functions.zh: 返回垂直滚动偏移量。
functions.en: Return the vertical scroll offset.

functions.zh: 返回布局或尺寸索引的内容总长度。
functions.en: Return the total content extent of the layout or size index.

functions.zh: 返回有效滚动偏移上限。
functions.en: Return the maximum valid scroll offset.

functions.zh: 返回逻辑偏移与滚动条值的转换器。
functions.en: Return the logical offset and scrollbar value mapper.

functions.zh: 返回逻辑偏移与滚动条值的转换器。
functions.en: Return the logical offset and scrollbar value mapper.

functions.zh: 设置按项目或像素滚动模式。
functions.en: Set the item-based or pixel-based wheel scrolling mode.

functions.zh: 返回按项目或像素滚动模式。
functions.en: Return the item-based or pixel-based wheel scrolling mode.

functions.zh: 设置滚轮每步逻辑像素数。
functions.en: Set the logical pixels per wheel step.

functions.zh: 返回滚轮每步逻辑像素数。
functions.en: Return the logical pixels per wheel step.

functions.zh: 设置滚轮每步项目数。
functions.en: Set the items per wheel step.

functions.zh: 返回滚轮每步项目数。
functions.en: Return the items per wheel step.

functions.zh: 设置垂直滚动偏移量。
functions.en: Set the vertical scroll offset.

functions.zh: 按逻辑像素增量滚动，并限制到当前有效滚动范围。
functions.en: Scroll by a logical-pixel delta, clamped to the current valid range.

functions.zh: 设置统一或可变高度策略。
functions.en: Set the uniform or variable item height strategy.

defaults.zh: ItemHeightMode::Uniform；Flow / Masonry / Wrap 使用各自布局接口，不支持此继承设置。
defaults.en: ItemHeightMode::Uniform; Flow / Masonry / Wrap use their own layout APIs and do not support this inherited setting.

functions.zh: 返回统一或可变高度策略。
functions.en: Return the uniform or variable item height strategy.

defaults.zh: ItemHeightMode::Uniform；Flow / Masonry / Wrap 使用各自布局接口，不支持此继承设置。
defaults.en: ItemHeightMode::Uniform; Flow / Masonry / Wrap use their own layout APIs and do not support this inherited setting.

functions.zh: 设置统一高度模式行高。
functions.en: Set the row height in uniform-height mode.

notes.zh: 统一高度设为 0 且开启自动测量时，使用首个物化项确定高度。Flow/Masonry/Wrap 使用专用尺寸 API，不支持套用内核自动行高测量。
notes.en: Uniform height 0 with automatic measurement uses the first materialized item to determine height. Flow/Masonry/Wrap use dedicated size APIs rather than kernel automatic row measurement.

functions.zh: 返回统一高度模式行高。
functions.en: Return the row height in uniform-height mode.

notes.zh: 统一高度设为 0 且开启自动测量时，使用首个物化项确定高度。Flow/Masonry/Wrap 使用专用尺寸 API，不支持套用内核自动行高测量。
notes.en: Uniform height 0 with automatic measurement uses the first materialized item to determine height. Flow/Masonry/Wrap use dedicated size APIs rather than kernel automatic row measurement.

functions.zh: 设置未测量项目估计高度。
functions.en: Set the estimated height of unmeasured items.

functions.zh: 返回未测量项目估计高度。
functions.en: Return the estimated height of unmeasured items.

functions.zh: 设置物化后自动测量高度的开关。
functions.en: Set the automatic measurement of materialized item heights.

notes.zh: 统一高度设为 0 且开启自动测量时，使用首个物化项确定高度。Flow/Masonry/Wrap 使用专用尺寸 API，不支持套用内核自动行高测量。
notes.en: Uniform height 0 with automatic measurement uses the first materialized item to determine height. Flow/Masonry/Wrap use dedicated size APIs rather than kernel automatic row measurement.

defaults.zh: true；Flow / Masonry / Wrap 构造时关闭且不支持开启，使用各自布局接口。
defaults.en: true; Flow / Masonry / Wrap disable this in their constructors and do not support enabling it; use their own layout APIs.

functions.zh: 返回物化后自动测量高度的开关。
functions.en: Return the automatic measurement of materialized item heights.

notes.zh: 统一高度设为 0 且开启自动测量时，使用首个物化项确定高度。Flow/Masonry/Wrap 使用专用尺寸 API，不支持套用内核自动行高测量。
notes.en: Uniform height 0 with automatic measurement uses the first materialized item to determine height. Flow/Masonry/Wrap use dedicated size APIs rather than kernel automatic row measurement.

defaults.zh: true；Flow / Masonry / Wrap 构造时关闭且不支持开启，使用各自布局接口。
defaults.en: true; Flow / Masonry / Wrap disable this in their constructors and do not support enabling it; use their own layout APIs.

functions.zh: 返回当前视口及布局计算出的可见项目范围。
functions.en: Return the visible item ranges resolved by the viewport and layout.

functions.zh: 设置顶部冻结行数。
functions.en: Set the number of top frozen rows.

defaults.zh: 0；无冻结行，仅支持行 pane 的视图适用。Tree / TreeTable / Flow / Masonry / Wrap 不支持。
defaults.en: 0; no frozen rows; only views supporting row panes apply. Tree / TreeTable / Flow / Masonry / Wrap do not support them.

functions.zh: 返回顶部冻结行数。
functions.en: Return the number of top frozen rows.

defaults.zh: 0；无冻结行，仅支持行 pane 的视图适用。Tree / TreeTable / Flow / Masonry / Wrap 不支持。
defaults.en: 0; no frozen rows; only views supporting row panes apply. Tree / TreeTable / Flow / Masonry / Wrap do not support them.

functions.zh: 设置底部冻结行数。
functions.en: Set the number of bottom frozen rows.

defaults.zh: 0；无冻结行，仅支持行 pane 的视图适用。Tree / TreeTable / Flow / Masonry / Wrap 不支持。
defaults.en: 0; no frozen rows; only views supporting row panes apply. Tree / TreeTable / Flow / Masonry / Wrap do not support them.

functions.zh: 返回底部冻结行数。
functions.en: Return the number of bottom frozen rows.

defaults.zh: 0；无冻结行，仅支持行 pane 的视图适用。Tree / TreeTable / Flow / Masonry / Wrap 不支持。
defaults.en: 0; no frozen rows; only views supporting row panes apply. Tree / TreeTable / Flow / Masonry / Wrap do not support them.

functions.zh: 判断当前窗格或指定行列是否固定在冻结区域。
functions.en: Check whether the pane or specified row/column belongs to a frozen region.

functions.zh: 返回当前行窗格集合。
functions.en: Return the current row pane collection.

functions.zh: 查询对应项目、单元格、窗格或合并区域的矩形。视图结果为视口坐标；布局策略结果为布局坐标；屏外矩形可超出可见区域。
functions.en: Query the item, cell, pane or span rectangle. View results use viewport coordinates; layout policies use layout coordinates. Offscreen rectangles may extend beyond the visible area.

functions.zh: 返回当前视口及布局计算出的可见项目范围。
functions.en: Return the visible item ranges resolved by the viewport and layout.

functions.zh: 设置冻结行窗格分隔线样式。
functions.en: Set the row pane separator style.

defaults.zh: width = 1，color 无效（视图默认分隔色），lineStyle = Qt::SolidLine。
defaults.en: width = 1, invalid color (view default separator color), lineStyle = Qt::SolidLine.

functions.zh: 返回冻结行窗格分隔线样式。
functions.en: Return the row pane separator style.

defaults.zh: width = 1，color 无效（视图默认分隔色），lineStyle = Qt::SolidLine。
defaults.en: width = 1, invalid color (view default separator color), lineStyle = Qt::SolidLine.

functions.zh: 返回行窗格分隔线向左延伸长度。
functions.en: Return the left extension of row pane separators.

functions.zh: 返回行窗格分隔线颜色。
functions.en: Return the row pane separator color.

functions.zh: 返回列或行窗格分隔线矩形集合。
functions.en: Return the column or row pane separator rectangles.

functions.zh: 返回主滚动窗格的裁剪宿主，无需裁剪时可能为空。
functions.en: Return the clipping host of the primary scrolling pane; may be null when clipping is unnecessary.

functions.zh: 返回当前物化的 cell、项目或 section 数量。
functions.en: Return the current materialized cell, item or section count.

functions.zh: 返回当前保留的屏外项目数。
functions.en: Return the current pinned offscreen item count.

functions.zh: 查询当前物化控件；屏外未物化时可为空，不代表模型项或选择状态不存在。
functions.en: Query the currently materialized widget. It may be null offscreen; that does not mean the model item or selection is absent.

functions.zh: 从物化控件反查当前绑定索引。复用后索引会变化，不应把控件地址当作永久业务标识。
functions.en: Resolve a materialized widget to its current bound index. Recycling changes bindings; a widget address is not a permanent business identity.

functions.zh: 返回当前物化的项目或 section 记录。
functions.en: Return the currently materialized item or section records.

functions.zh: 返回当前池内空闲控件数；带类型参数的重载只统计该类型。
functions.en: Return the current pooled idle widget count; typed overloads count only that type.

functions.zh: 返回累计创建控件数。
functions.en: Return the cumulative created widget count.

functions.zh: 返回累计销毁控件数。
functions.en: Return the cumulative destroyed widget count.

functions.zh: 判断是否存在尚未执行的布局刷新。
functions.en: Check whether a relayout is pending.

functions.zh: 立即执行已排队的布局刷新，适合必须同步读取新几何的情况。
functions.en: Flush a pending relayout immediately when fresh geometry must be read synchronously.

functions.zh: 项目单击或双击时发出，参数为命中的模型索引。
functions.en: Emitted for an item click or double-click, with the hit model index.

functions.zh: 项目单击或双击时发出，参数为命中的模型索引。
functions.en: Emitted for an item click or double-click, with the hit model index.

functions.zh: 项目被激活时发出，参数为目标模型索引。
functions.en: Emitted when an item is activated, with the target model index.

functions.signature: void itemDropped(const QModelIndex &parent, int row, int column, Qt::DropAction action);
functions.zh: 一次项目放置完成后发出，用于观察结果；不要再次重复执行模型移动。
functions.en: Emitted after an item drop completes. Observe the result without duplicating the model move.

functions.zh: 选择模型更换后发出；外部信号连接应跟随新选择模型。
functions.en: Emitted after the selection model changes; reconnect external selection observers as needed.

functions.zh: 可见范围及物化控件更新后发出，可用于轻量诊断与业务观察。
functions.en: Emitted after visible ranges and materialized widgets update, for lightweight diagnostics or observation.

functions.zh: 构造 VirtualListView；按此重载传入父对象、模型或布局参数。带 parent 的 QObject/QWidget 遵循 Qt 父子生命周期。
functions.en: Construct VirtualListView with the parent, model or layout arguments in this overload. QObject/QWidget parent arguments follow Qt parent-child lifetime rules.

functions.zh: 销毁 VirtualListView 并释放其拥有的资源；不在析构回调中继续使用该对象。
functions.en: Destroy VirtualListView and release its owned resources; do not keep using the object during destruction callbacks.

functions.zh: 连接新的数据模型并更新布局、选择与物化状态；模型生命周期需覆盖视图使用期间。不要用重复 setModel 代替数据变更通知。
functions.en: Connect a new data model and update layout, selection and materialization. Keep the model alive while in use; do not replace change notifications with repeated setModel calls.

defaults.en: nullptr; no model is attached initially.

functions.zh: 设置展示子项所属模型根索引。
functions.en: Set the model root index whose children are displayed.

defaults.zh: 无效 QModelIndex，显示模型根级。
defaults.en: Invalid QModelIndex; the model root is displayed.

functions.zh: 返回展示子项所属模型根索引。
functions.en: Return the model root index whose children are displayed.

defaults.zh: 无效 QModelIndex，显示模型根级。
defaults.en: Invalid QModelIndex; the model root is displayed.

functions.zh: 返回列表使用的布局策略对象。
functions.en: Return the layout policy used by the list.

functions.zh: 设置指示器或让位动画反馈模式。
functions.en: Set the indicator or reorder-animation feedback mode.

defaults.zh: DragFeedbackMode::RowMoveAnimation；不满足动画条件时回退到指示器。
defaults.en: DragFeedbackMode::RowMoveAnimation; unsupported cases fall back to the indicator.

functions.zh: 返回指示器或让位动画反馈模式。
functions.en: Return the indicator or reorder-animation feedback mode.

defaults.zh: DragFeedbackMode::RowMoveAnimation；不满足动画条件时回退到指示器。
defaults.en: DragFeedbackMode::RowMoveAnimation; unsupported cases fall back to the indicator.

functions.zh: 设置拖动让位动画时长（毫秒）。
functions.en: Set the drag reorder duration in milliseconds.

functions.zh: 返回拖动让位动画时长（毫秒）。
functions.en: Return the drag reorder duration in milliseconds.

functions.zh: 设置拖动让位缓动曲线。
functions.en: Set the drag reorder easing curve.

functions.zh: 返回拖动让位缓动曲线。
functions.en: Return the drag reorder easing curve.

functions.zh: 设置行分割线可见性。
functions.en: Set the row grid line visibility.

functions.zh: 返回行分割线可见性。
functions.en: Return the row grid line visibility.

functions.zh: 设置行分割线宽度。
functions.en: Set the row grid line width.

defaults.zh: 1 像素；缩放与对齐遵循该分割线接口的规则。
defaults.en: 1 pixel; scaling and alignment follow this separator API.

functions.zh: 返回行分割线宽度。
functions.en: Return the row grid line width.

defaults.zh: 1 像素；缩放与对齐遵循该分割线接口的规则。
defaults.en: 1 pixel; scaling and alignment follow this separator API.

functions.zh: 设置行分割线颜色。
functions.en: Set the row grid line color.

defaults.zh: 无效 QColor；绘制时使用 QPalette::Mid。

functions.zh: 返回行分割线颜色。
functions.en: Return the row grid line color.

defaults.zh: 无效 QColor；绘制时使用 QPalette::Mid。

functions.zh: 设置hover 或选中背景绘制开关。
functions.en: Set the hover or selection background painting setting.

defaults.zh: true；内置 hover / selection 背景启用。
defaults.en: true; built-in hover / selection backgrounds are enabled.

functions.zh: 返回hover 或选中背景绘制开关。
functions.en: Return the hover or selection background painting setting.

defaults.zh: true；内置 hover / selection 背景启用。
defaults.en: true; built-in hover / selection backgrounds are enabled.

functions.zh: 设置状态背景圆角半径。
functions.en: Set the state background corner radius.

functions.zh: 返回状态背景圆角半径。
functions.en: Return the state background corner radius.

functions.zh: 设置树或列表状态背景水平范围。
functions.en: Set the horizontal tree or list state background extent.

notes.zh: 范围与边距影响状态背景和命中区域，不改变模型选择数据。固定高度在剩余区域内居中并限制到可用高度。WidgetOnly 按控件实际宽度；含 Icon 的模式在无图标或图标隐藏时退回不含 Icon 的范围。TreeTable 使用固定整行策略。
notes.en: Extent and insets affect backgrounds and hit regions without rewriting model selection data. A fixed height is centered and clamped to available height. WidgetOnly follows actual widget width; icon-inclusive modes omit icon space when no icon is shown. TreeTable uses its fixed whole-row policy.

functions.en: Return the horizontal tree or list state background extent.

notes.zh: 范围与边距影响状态背景和命中区域，不改变模型选择数据。固定高度在剩余区域内居中并限制到可用高度。WidgetOnly 按控件实际宽度；含 Icon 的模式在无图标或图标隐藏时退回不含 Icon 的范围。TreeTable 使用固定整行策略。
notes.en: Extent and insets affect backgrounds and hit regions without rewriting model selection data. A fixed height is centered and clamped to available height. WidgetOnly follows actual widget width; icon-inclusive modes omit icon space when no icon is shown. TreeTable uses its fixed whole-row policy.

functions.zh: 设置状态背景内缩边距。
functions.en: Set the state background insets.

notes.zh: 范围与边距影响状态背景和命中区域，不改变模型选择数据。固定高度在剩余区域内居中并限制到可用高度。WidgetOnly 按控件实际宽度；含 Icon 的模式在无图标或图标隐藏时退回不含 Icon 的范围。TreeTable 使用固定整行策略。

WidgetOnly follows actual widget width; icon-inclusive modes omit icon space when no icon is shown. TreeTable uses its fixed whole-row policy.

functions.zh: 设置状态背景内缩边距。
functions.en: Set the state background insets.

notes.zh: 范围与边距影响状态背景和命中区域，不改变模型选择数据。固定高度在剩余区域内居中并限制到可用高度。WidgetOnly 按控件实际宽度；含 Icon 的模式在无图标或图标隐藏时退回不含 Icon 的范围。TreeTable 使用固定整行策略。
notes.en: Extent and insets affect backgrounds and hit regions without rewriting model selection data. A fixed height is centered and clamped to available height. WidgetOnly follows actual widget width; icon-inclusive modes omit icon space when no icon is shown. TreeTable uses its fixed whole-row policy.

functions.zh: 返回状态背景内缩边距。
functions.en: Return the state background insets.

notes.zh: 范围与边距影响状态背景和命中区域，不改变模型选择数据。固定高度在剩余区域内居中并限制到可用高度。WidgetOnly 按控件实际宽度；含 Icon 的模式在无图标或图标隐藏时退回不含 Icon 的范围。TreeTable 使用固定整行策略。
notes.en: Extent and insets affect backgrounds and hit regions without rewriting model selection data. A fixed height is centered and clamped to available height. WidgetOnly follows actual widget width; icon-inclusive modes omit icon space when no icon is shown. TreeTable uses its fixed whole-row policy.

functions.zh: 设置状态背景固定高度；0 使用可用高度。
functions.en: Set the fixed state background height; 0 uses available height.

notes.zh: 范围与边距影响状态背景和命中区域，不改变模型选择数据。固定高度在剩余区域内居中并限制到可用高度。WidgetOnly 按控件实际宽度；含 Icon 的模式在无图标或图标隐藏时退回不含 Icon 的范围。TreeTable 使用固定整行策略。
notes.en: Extent and insets affect backgrounds and hit regions without rewriting model selection data. A fixed height is centered and clamped to available height. WidgetOnly follows actual widget width; icon-inclusive modes omit icon space when no icon is shown. TreeTable uses its fixed whole-row policy.

defaults.zh: 0；不固定高度，按项几何与状态边距计算。
defaults.en: 0; no fixed height; item geometry and state margins determine the height.

functions.zh: 返回状态背景固定高度；0 使用可用高度。
functions.en: Return the fixed state background height; 0 uses available height.

notes.zh: 范围与边距影响状态背景和命中区域，不改变模型选择数据。固定高度在剩余区域内居中并限制到可用高度。WidgetOnly 按控件实际宽度；含 Icon 的模式在无图标或图标隐藏时退回不含 Icon 的范围。TreeTable 使用固定整行策略。

WidgetOnly follows actual widget width; icon-inclusive modes omit icon space when no icon is shown. TreeTable uses its fixed whole-row policy.

defaults.zh: 0；不固定高度，按项几何与状态边距计算。
defaults.en: 0; no fixed height; item geometry and state margins determine the height.

functions.zh: 命中给定坐标对应的项目；视图接口使用视口坐标，布局策略使用布局坐标。空白区域返回无效结果。
functions.en: Hit-test an item at a position. Views use viewport coordinates; layout policies use layout coordinates. Blank space returns an invalid result.

functions.zh: 返回行窗格分隔线颜色。
functions.en: Return the row pane separator color.

functions.zh: 构造 VirtualMasonryView；按此重载传入父对象、模型或布局参数。带 parent 的 QObject/QWidget 遵循 Qt 父子生命周期。
functions.en: Construct VirtualMasonryView with the parent, model or layout arguments in this overload. QObject/QWidget parent arguments follow Qt parent-child lifetime rules.

functions.zh: 连接新的数据模型并更新布局、选择与物化状态；模型生命周期需覆盖视图使用期间。不要用重复 setModel 代替数据变更通知。
functions.en: Connect a new data model and update layout, selection and materialization. Keep the model alive while in use; do not replace change notifications with repeated setModel calls.

defaults.en: nullptr; no model is attached initially.

functions.signature: void setAdapter(WidgetAdapter *adapter, bool takeOwnership = false) override;
functions.zh: 设置项目控件适配器。
functions.en: Set the item widget adapter.

notes.zh: takeOwnership 默认为 false，未转移所有权时调用方须保证 adapter 存活。RowWidgets 使用 TableWidgetAdapter，CellWidgets 使用 CellWidgetAdapter。创建控件和绑定数据应分离；复用时清除旧业务关联。
notes.en: takeOwnership defaults to false; the caller must keep a non-owned adapter alive. RowWidgets uses TableWidgetAdapter and CellWidgets uses CellWidgetAdapter. Separate widget creation from binding and clear obsolete business associations on reuse.

defaults.zh: nullptr；初始没有业务 adapter。takeOwnership 参数默认 false。
defaults.en: nullptr; no application adapter is installed. The takeOwnership argument defaults to false.

functions.zh: 设置展示子项所属模型根索引。
functions.en: Set the model root index whose children are displayed.

defaults.zh: 无效 QModelIndex，显示模型根级。
defaults.en: Invalid QModelIndex; the model root is displayed.

functions.zh: 返回展示子项所属模型根索引。
functions.en: Return the model root index whose children are displayed.

defaults.zh: 无效 QModelIndex，显示模型根级。
defaults.en: Invalid QModelIndex; the model root is displayed.

functions.zh: 设置单元格或项目的宽度上下限，影响换行和自动列数计算。
functions.en: Set cell or item width bounds used by wrapping and automatic column-count calculations.

defaults.zh: minimum = 100，maximum = 200 逻辑像素；最终列宽由视口和列数决定。
defaults.en: minimum = 100, maximum = 200 logical pixels; effective column width depends on viewport width and column count.

functions.zh: 返回单元格或项目宽度下限或上限。
functions.en: Return the minimum or maximum cell or item width.

functions.zh: 返回单元格或项目宽度下限或上限。
functions.en: Return the minimum or maximum cell or item width.

functions.zh: 设置逻辑列数。
functions.en: Set the logical column count.

defaults.zh: 0；自动根据视口宽度和列宽范围计算列数。
defaults.en: 0; derives the column count from viewport width and the width range.

functions.zh: 返回逻辑列数。
functions.en: Return the logical column count.

defaults.zh: 0；自动根据视口宽度和列宽范围计算列数。
defaults.en: 0; derives the column count from viewport width and the width range.

functions.zh: 设置内容列间距。
functions.en: Set the spacing between content columns.

functions.zh: 返回内容列间距。
functions.en: Return the spacing between content columns.

functions.zh: 设置行间距。
functions.en: Set the spacing between rows.

functions.zh: 返回行间距。
functions.en: Return the spacing between rows.

functions.zh: 设置间距中心或两侧分割线模式。
functions.en: Set the grid line placement at spacing centers or edges.

notes.zh: 默认 SpacingCenter：在间距中心绘制，交叉线始终穿过间距，且外侧补半间距；零间距时不重复画线。SpacingEdges 在间距两侧绘制，只有这个模式允许控制是否穿过交叉间距。是否穿过表头使用单独开关。
notes.en: SpacingCenter is the default: lines run through gap centers, cross gaps unconditionally, and use outer half-gaps; zero spacing does not duplicate lines. SpacingEdges draws both gap edges and alone allows disabling crossings through perpendicular gaps. Header crossings have independent switches.

defaults.zh: GridLinePlacement::SpacingCenter；无间距时回退到项边界，不重复绘制。
defaults.en: GridLinePlacement::SpacingCenter; without spacing, lines fall back to item boundaries without duplicates.

functions.zh: 设置内容四周外边距。
functions.en: Set the margins around the content.

functions.zh: 返回内容四周外边距。
functions.en: Return the margins around the content.

functions.zh: 设置内容或表头间距背景颜色。
functions.en: Set the content or header gap background color.

defaults.zh: 无效 QColor；未指定间距色，随内容背景绘制，默认 QPalette::Base。
defaults.en: Invalid QColor; gaps follow the content background, QPalette::Base by default.

functions.zh: 设置统一或可变高度策略。
functions.en: Set the uniform or variable item height strategy.

functions.zh: 返回统一或可变高度策略。
functions.en: Return the uniform or variable item height strategy.

functions.zh: 设置项目统一固定高度。
functions.en: Set the uniform fixed item height.

functions.zh: 返回项目统一固定高度。
functions.en: Return the uniform fixed item height.

functions.zh: 设置项目宽高比（宽 / 高）。
functions.en: Set the item aspect ratio (width / height).

functions.zh: 返回项目宽高比（宽 / 高）。
functions.en: Return the item aspect ratio (width / height).

functions.zh: 设置单个或批量项目的估计尺寸；用于尚未测量项目的布局和滚动范围估算。
functions.en: Set individual or bulk size estimates used for layout and scroll ranges before measurement.

defaults.zh: 无逐项估算尺寸覆盖；按当前高度模式和 adapter 的估算值布局。
defaults.en: No per-item estimated-size overrides; layout uses the height mode and adapter estimates.

functions.zh: 设置单个或批量项目的估计尺寸；用于尚未测量项目的布局和滚动范围估算。
functions.en: Set individual or bulk size estimates used for layout and scroll ranges before measurement.

defaults.zh: 无逐项估算尺寸覆盖；按当前高度模式和 adapter 的估算值布局。
defaults.en: No per-item estimated-size overrides; layout uses the height mode and adapter estimates.

functions.zh: 设置指定项目的高度，更新其后项目的几何位置。
functions.en: Set an item height and update subsequent item positions.

defaults.zh: 无逐项高度覆盖；默认 Fixed 模式使用 100。
defaults.en: No per-item height overrides; the default Fixed mode uses 100.

functions.zh: 使指定布局或尺寸缓存失效；下次布局重新测量或计算。仅在内容尺寸确实变化时调用。
functions.en: Invalidate the indicated layout or size cache for subsequent measurement or calculation. Use only when content dimensions actually change.

functions.zh: 设置项目高度动画开关。
functions.en: Set the item height animation setting.

functions.zh: 返回项目高度动画开关。
functions.en: Return the item height animation setting.

functions.zh: 设置项目高度动画时长（毫秒）。
functions.en: Set the item height animation duration in milliseconds.

functions.zh: 返回项目高度动画时长（毫秒）。
functions.en: Return the item height animation duration in milliseconds.

functions.zh: 返回瀑布流项目所在列。
functions.en: Return the masonry column containing the item.

functions.zh: 查询对应项目、单元格、窗格或合并区域的矩形。视图结果为视口坐标；布局策略结果为布局坐标；屏外矩形可超出可见区域。
functions.en: Query the item, cell, pane or span rectangle. View results use viewport coordinates; layout policies use layout coordinates. Offscreen rectangles may extend beyond the visible area.

functions.zh: 命中给定坐标对应的项目；视图接口使用视口坐标，布局策略使用布局坐标。空白区域返回无效结果。
functions.en: Hit-test an item at a position. Views use viewport coordinates; layout policies use layout coordinates. Blank space returns an invalid result.

functions.zh: 设置hover 或选中背景绘制开关。
functions.en: Set the hover or selection background painting setting.

defaults.zh: true；内置 hover / selection 背景启用。
defaults.en: true; built-in hover / selection backgrounds are enabled.

functions.zh: 返回hover 或选中背景绘制开关。
functions.en: Return the hover or selection background painting setting.

defaults.zh: true；内置 hover / selection 背景启用。
defaults.en: true; built-in hover / selection backgrounds are enabled.

functions.zh: 设置状态背景圆角半径。
functions.en: Set the state background corner radius.

functions.zh: 返回状态背景圆角半径。
functions.en: Return the state background corner radius.

functions.zh: 设置纵向分割线可见性。
functions.en: Set the vertical grid line visibility.

functions.zh: 返回纵向分割线可见性。
functions.en: Return the vertical grid line visibility.

functions.zh: 设置横向分割线可见性。
functions.en: Set the horizontal grid line visibility.

functions.zh: 返回横向分割线可见性。
functions.en: Return the horizontal grid line visibility.

functions.zh: 设置纵向分割线宽度。
functions.en: Set the vertical grid line width.

defaults.zh: 1 像素；缩放与对齐遵循该分割线接口的规则。
defaults.en: 1 pixel; scaling and alignment follow this separator API.

functions.zh: 返回纵向分割线宽度。
functions.en: Return the vertical grid line width.

defaults.zh: 1 像素；缩放与对齐遵循该分割线接口的规则。
defaults.en: 1 pixel; scaling and alignment follow this separator API.

functions.zh: 设置横向分割线宽度。
functions.en: Set the horizontal grid line width.

defaults.zh: 1 像素；缩放与对齐遵循该分割线接口的规则。
defaults.en: 1 pixel; scaling and alignment follow this separator API.

functions.zh: 返回横向分割线宽度。
functions.en: Return the horizontal grid line width.

defaults.zh: 1 像素；缩放与对齐遵循该分割线接口的规则。
defaults.en: 1 pixel; scaling and alignment follow this separator API.

functions.zh: 设置纵向分割线颜色。
functions.en: Set the vertical grid line color.

defaults.zh: 无效 QColor；绘制时使用 QPalette::Mid。

functions.zh: 返回纵向分割线颜色。
functions.en: Return the vertical grid line color.

defaults.zh: 无效 QColor；绘制时使用 QPalette::Mid。

functions.zh: 设置横向分割线颜色。
functions.en: Set the horizontal grid line color.

defaults.zh: 无效 QColor；绘制时使用 QPalette::Mid。

functions.zh: 返回横向分割线颜色。
functions.en: Return the horizontal grid line color.

defaults.zh: 无效 QColor；绘制时使用 QPalette::Mid。

functions.en: Set the whether vertical lines cross row gaps in edge mode.

defaults.zh: true；SpacingCenter 始终穿过间距，此开关仅在 SpacingEdges 生效。
defaults.en: true; SpacingCenter always crosses gaps; this switch only affects SpacingEdges.

functions.zh: 返回两侧模式下纵向线穿过行间距开关。
functions.en: Return the whether vertical lines cross row gaps in edge mode.

functions.en: Emitted when the corresponding layout changes so clients can update layout-dependent content.

functions.zh: 设置拖放目标解释方式。
functions.en: Set the drop target interpretation mode.

functions.zh: 返回拖放目标解释方式。
functions.en: Return the drop target interpretation mode.

functions.zh: 设置指示器或让位动画反馈模式。
functions.en: Set the indicator or reorder-animation feedback mode.

defaults.zh: DragFeedbackMode::RowMoveAnimation；不满足动画条件时回退到指示器。
defaults.en: DragFeedbackMode::RowMoveAnimation; unsupported cases fall back to the indicator.

examples.zh: 为表格启用自动起拖和虚线插入指示器。view 为 VirtualTableView；模型必须提供拖放 flags、MIME 与移动/放下实现。这里不启用 setMoveRemovesSourceRows：若 dropMimeData() 自己移动原项，再删除源行会重复移除。
examples.en: Enable automatic table dragging with a dashed insertion indicator. view is a VirtualTableView; its model must implement drag/drop flags, MIME and move/drop behavior. setMoveRemovesSourceRows is intentionally left disabled: if dropMimeData() already moves the originals, removing source rows again would delete them twice.

functions.zh: 返回指示器或让位动画反馈模式。
functions.en: Return the indicator or reorder-animation feedback mode.

defaults.zh: DragFeedbackMode::RowMoveAnimation；不满足动画条件时回退到指示器。
defaults.en: DragFeedbackMode::RowMoveAnimation; unsupported cases fall back to the indicator.

functions.zh: 设置拖动让位动画时长（毫秒）。
functions.en: Set the drag reorder duration in milliseconds.

functions.zh: 返回拖动让位动画时长（毫秒）。
functions.en: Return the drag reorder duration in milliseconds.

functions.zh: 设置拖动让位缓动曲线。
functions.en: Set the drag reorder easing curve.

functions.zh: 返回拖动让位缓动曲线。
functions.en: Return the drag reorder easing curve.

functions.zh: 构造 VirtualTableView；按此重载传入父对象、模型或布局参数。带 parent 的 QObject/QWidget 遵循 Qt 父子生命周期。
functions.en: Construct VirtualTableView with the parent, model or layout arguments in this overload. QObject/QWidget parent arguments follow Qt parent-child lifetime rules.

functions.zh: 销毁 VirtualTableView 并释放其拥有的资源；不在析构回调中继续使用该对象。
functions.en: Destroy VirtualTableView and release its owned resources; do not keep using the object during destruction callbacks.

examples.en: Style the header container separately from its sections. view is a VirtualTableView; horizontalHeader() returns the current header interface. Model ForegroundRole / TextAlignmentRole and custom painting may override text defaults.

functions.en: Return whether the vertical header is actually shown in the current layout, rather than only its configured visibility.

notes.en: Header areas, individual sections, the content body and gaps are separate layers. Changing the header area does not replace section fill; use sectionBackgroundColor for sections. QSS rules may override the relevant widget palette or styled painting.

defaults.zh: 无效 QColor；由表头样式或 QSS 决定，不是固定 RGB。
defaults.en: Invalid QColor; header style or QSS supplies the color, not a fixed RGB.

functions.zh: 返回指定方向表头区域背景颜色。
functions.en: Return the background color of the specified header area.

functions.zh: 设置点击水平表头选整列开关，默认关闭。
functions.en: Set the column selection by horizontal header click, disabled by default.

examples.zh: 按单元格选择，并仅在内容区域绘制状态背景。view 为 VirtualTableView；ExtendedSelection 支持 Ctrl/Shift，SelectItems 同时决定 hover/selection 的单元格范围。关闭表头状态同步不影响内容选择。
examples.en: Select cells and paint state backgrounds only in the body. view is a VirtualTableView. ExtendedSelection supports Ctrl/Shift, while SelectItems sets the cell extent for both hover and selection. Disabling header state painting does not disable body selection.

functions.zh: 返回点击水平表头选整列开关，默认关闭。

functions.zh: 返回表头对应的 hover、选中和动画状态，用于保持内容与表头同步。
functions.en: Return header hover, selection and animation state to keep header and content synchronized.

functions.zh: 返回鼠标拖动行号排序开关。

functions.zh: 设置鼠标拖动列宽开关。
functions.en: Set the mouse column-resize setting.

examples.zh: 让可见列总宽度与间距填满 viewport，并允许鼠标拖动列边界。view 为至少有三列的 VirtualTableView；先设置初始列宽，再进入 FitViewport。极窄或极宽时会按需放宽列宽限制，以维持整体宽度匹配。
examples.en: Fit visible column widths plus gaps to the viewport and enable boundary dragging. view is a VirtualTableView with at least three columns. Establish initial widths before entering FitViewport. At extreme viewport sizes, width limits are relaxed as needed to maintain the total extent.

functions.zh: 返回鼠标拖动列宽开关。
functions.en: Return the mouse column-resize setting.

functions.zh: 设置鼠标拖动行号边缘调整行高开关。

functions.zh: 返回鼠标拖动行号边缘调整行高开关。
functions.en: Return the row resizing by dragging row header edges.

functions.zh: 返回逻辑列数。
functions.en: Return the logical column count.

functions.zh: 返回指定逻辑列的尺寸、位置和可见性信息。
functions.en: Return the size, position and visibility of the specified logical column.

functions.zh: 返回指定逻辑列宽度。
functions.en: Return the width of the specified logical column.

notes.zh: 普通比例拉伸在手动拖动或显式设置列宽后整体取消。FitViewport 是独立模式，让列总宽适配视口，并按拖动边缘在另一侧列中分摊宽度；不要混同于普通 stretch 权重。
notes.en: Ordinary proportional stretching is cleared by manual resizing or explicit column widths. FitViewport is a separate mode that fits total column width to the viewport and distributes a resize across columns on the corresponding side; it is distinct from ordinary stretch weights.

functions.zh: 设置内容列间距。
functions.en: Set the spacing between content columns.

examples.zh: 设置间距中心分割线，并在水平表头下添加完整行间距。view 为 VirtualTableView；Horizontal 对应表头下方，Vertical 对应行号条右侧。这里额外表头间距为 rowSpacing() 的 8 像素，不是独立数值。
examples.en: Use centered gap separators and add a full row gap below the horizontal header. view is a VirtualTableView. Horizontal means below the column header; Vertical means right of the row-number strip. The extra header gap is rowSpacing(), 8 pixels here, rather than an independent size.

functions.zh: 返回内容列间距。
functions.en: Return the spacing between content columns.

functions.zh: 设置指定方向表头与内容完整间距开关。
functions.en: Set the full gap between the specified header and content.

notes.zh: 默认两个方向都关闭。Horizontal 使用完整 rowSpacing 在水平表头下方留空；Vertical 使用完整 columnSpacing 在垂直表头右侧留空。只开开关而间距为 0 不会增加空隙；隐藏表头仍使用普通内容外侧间距。
notes.en: Disabled in both orientations by default. Horizontal adds a full rowSpacing below the horizontal header; Vertical adds a full columnSpacing after the vertical header. Enabling with zero spacing adds no gap. Hidden headers retain ordinary outer content spacing.

defaults.zh: 两个方向均为 false；不插入额外完整间距。SpacingCenter 外侧半间距仍按布局规则处理。
defaults.en: false in both orientations; no additional full gap. SpacingCenter outer half-gaps still follow layout rules.

examples.zh: 设置间距中心分割线，并在水平表头下添加完整行间距。view 为 VirtualTableView；Horizontal 对应表头下方，Vertical 对应行号条右侧。这里额外表头间距为 rowSpacing() 的 8 像素，不是独立数值。

functions.zh: 提供间距控件工厂以定制间距区域。优先只设置背景颜色，确实需要交互或复杂内容时再创建间距控件。
functions.en: Supply a spacing-widget factory to customize gaps. Prefer a background color alone unless the gap needs interaction or complex content.

defaults.zh: 工厂与 binder 均为空。

functions.zh: 提供间距控件工厂以定制间距区域。优先只设置背景颜色，确实需要交互或复杂内容时再创建间距控件。
functions.en: Supply a spacing-widget factory to customize gaps. Prefer a background color alone unless the gap needs interaction or complex content.

defaults.zh: 工厂与 binder 均为空。

functions.zh: 设置间距中心或两侧分割线模式。
functions.en: Set the grid line placement at spacing centers or edges.

notes.zh: 默认 SpacingCenter：在间距中心绘制，交叉线始终穿过间距，且外侧补半间距；零间距时不重复画线。SpacingEdges 在间距两侧绘制，只有这个模式允许控制是否穿过交叉间距。是否穿过表头使用单独开关。
notes.en: SpacingCenter is the default: lines run through gap centers, cross gaps unconditionally, and use outer half-gaps; zero spacing does not duplicate lines. SpacingEdges draws both gap edges and alone allows disabling crossings through perpendicular gaps. Header crossings have independent switches.

defaults.zh: GridLinePlacement::SpacingCenter；无间距时回退到项边界，不重复绘制。
defaults.en: GridLinePlacement::SpacingCenter; without spacing, lines fall back to item boundaries without duplicates.

examples.zh: 仅在间距两侧模式下关闭分割线穿过另一方向间距。view 为 VirtualTableView；SpacingCenter 模式始终穿过间距，不能靠这两个开关关闭。
examples.en: Disable separator crossing of perpendicular gaps in edge mode. view is a VirtualTableView. SpacingCenter always crosses gaps, so these two switches cannot disable crossing in that mode.

examples.en: Fit visible column widths plus gaps to the viewport and enable boundary dragging. view is a VirtualTableView with at least three columns. Establish initial widths before entering FitViewport. At extreme viewport sizes, width limits are relaxed as needed to maintain the total extent.
