functions.zh: 接收框架计算后的 hover、选中和动画进度；据此更新按钮等子控件，通常无需重复绘制框架状态背景。
functions.en: Receive framework-computed hover, selection and animation progress. Update child controls from this state; ordinarily do not duplicate framework background painting.

functions.signature: virtual void visualStateChanged(WidgetType type, QWidget *widget, const ItemBindingContext &context);
functions.zh: 接收框架计算后的 hover、选中和动画进度；据此更新按钮等子控件，通常无需重复绘制框架状态背景。
functions.en: Receive framework-computed hover, selection and animation progress. Update child controls from this state; ordinarily do not duplicate framework background painting.

functions.signature: virtual void unbindWidget(WidgetType type, QWidget *widget, const QModelIndex &index);
functions.zh: 解除控件与旧项目的业务关联，取消旧请求并清理临时状态，供下次复用。
functions.en: Detach the widget from its old item, cancel obsolete work and clear transient state before reuse.

functions.signature: virtual void unbindWidget(WidgetType type, QWidget *widget, const ItemBindingContext &context);
functions.zh: 解除控件与旧项目的业务关联，取消旧请求并清理临时状态，供下次复用。
functions.en: Detach the widget from its old item, cancel obsolete work and clear transient state before reuse.

functions.signature: virtual QSize estimatedSize(WidgetType type, const QModelIndex &index) const = 0;
functions.zh: 返回布局估计尺寸，用于控件物化前或测量前的布局。保持回调轻量。
functions.en: Return an estimated layout size used before materialization or measurement. Keep this callback inexpensive.

functions.zh: 构造 WidgetRecycler；按此重载传入父对象、模型或布局参数。带 parent 的 QObject/QWidget 遵循 Qt 父子生命周期。
functions.en: Construct WidgetRecycler with the parent, model or layout arguments in this overload. QObject/QWidget parent arguments follow Qt parent-child lifetime rules.

functions.zh: 销毁 WidgetRecycler 并释放其拥有的资源；不在析构回调中继续使用该对象。
functions.en: Destroy WidgetRecycler and release its owned resources; do not keep using the object during destruction callbacks.

functions.zh: 此复制或赋值操作被禁用；该对象不能按值复制。
functions.en: This copy or assignment operation is deleted; the object cannot be copied by value.

functions.zh: 此复制或赋值操作被禁用；该对象不能按值复制。
functions.en: This copy or assignment operation is deleted; the object cannot be copied by value.

functions.zh: 设置回收控件父控件。
functions.en: Set the recycled widget parent.

defaults.zh: 构造 parent 为 QWidget 时使用该对象，否则 nullptr。
defaults.en: Uses the constructor parent if it is a QWidget, otherwise nullptr.

functions.zh: 返回回收控件父控件。
functions.en: Return the recycled widget parent.

defaults.zh: 构造 parent 为 QWidget 时使用该对象，否则 nullptr。
defaults.en: Uses the constructor parent if it is a QWidget, otherwise nullptr.

functions.zh: 设置按 WidgetType 创建控件的工厂。
functions.en: Set the widget factory indexed by WidgetType.

defaults.zh: 空工厂；独立 recycler 不会创建控件，视图会安装自己的工厂。
defaults.en: Empty factory; a standalone recycler cannot create widgets, while views install their own factories.

functions.zh: 按 widgetType 从池中取出可复用控件；池空时通过工厂创建。
functions.en: Acquire a widget by type, reusing a pooled instance or creating one through the factory.

functions.zh: 将控件退回按类型分类的复用池。回收前由适配器解绑业务状态。
functions.en: Return a widget to its type-specific pool after adapter state has been unbound.

functions.zh: 将控件从回收器管理中移除并安排销毁。
functions.en: Remove a widget from recycler management and schedule its destruction.

functions.zh: 设置回收池容量上限。
functions.en: Set the recycler pool capacity limit.

notes.zh: 按 WidgetType 分别限制池容量；负数表示不限制。池满时回收控件会安排延迟删除。
notes.en: Limits apply per WidgetType; negative means unlimited. Recycling into a full pool schedules deferred deletion.

functions.zh: 返回回收池容量上限。
functions.en: Return the recycler pool capacity limit.

notes.zh: 按 WidgetType 分别限制池容量；负数表示不限制。池满时回收控件会安排延迟删除。
notes.en: Limits apply per WidgetType; negative means unlimited. Recycling into a full pool schedules deferred deletion.

functions.zh: 返回当前池内空闲控件数；带类型参数的重载只统计该类型。
functions.en: Return the current pooled idle widget count; typed overloads count only that type.

functions.zh: 返回当前池内空闲控件数；带类型参数的重载只统计该类型。
functions.en: Return the current pooled idle widget count; typed overloads count only that type.

functions.zh: 返回当前已借出控件数。
functions.en: Return the current acquired widget count.

functions.zh: 返回累计创建控件数。
functions.en: Return the cumulative created widget count.

functions.zh: 返回累计销毁控件数。
functions.en: Return the cumulative destroyed widget count.

functions.zh: 返回等待延迟销毁控件数。
functions.en: Return the widgets pending deferred destruction.

functions.zh: 返回累计获取控件次数。
functions.en: Return the cumulative widget acquisition count.

functions.zh: 返回累计复用已有控件次数。
functions.en: Return the cumulative widget reuse count.

functions.zh: 返回当前尚存活控件总数。
functions.en: Return the current live widget count.

functions.zh: 判断控件是否当前位于空闲回收池。
functions.en: Check whether a widget is currently in an idle recycler pool.

functions.zh: 将空闲池缩减至容量限制，释放多余控件。
functions.en: Trim idle pools to their capacity limits, releasing excess widgets.

functions.zh: 立即删除回收池中的全部空闲控件；活动控件不属于池内清理范围。
functions.en: Immediately delete all idle pooled widgets; active widgets are outside this pool cleanup.

functions.zh: 构造 WrapLayout；按此重载传入父对象、模型或布局参数。带 parent 的 QObject/QWidget 遵循 Qt 父子生命周期。
functions.en: Construct WrapLayout with the parent, model or layout arguments in this overload. QObject/QWidget parent arguments follow Qt parent-child lifetime rules.

functions.zh: 销毁 WrapLayout 并释放其拥有的资源；不在析构回调中继续使用该对象。
functions.en: Destroy WrapLayout and release its owned resources; do not keep using the object during destruction callbacks.

functions.zh: 将布局项加入换行布局，由布局管理其几何位置。
functions.en: Add a layout item to the wrapping layout, which manages its geometry.

functions.zh: 把控件加入指定位置；WrapLayout/WrapWidget 使用真实控件，不进行虚拟化回收。
functions.en: Add a widget at the requested position. WrapLayout/WrapWidget manage real widgets without virtualized recycling.

functions.zh: 返回布局、索引或范围中的项目数量。
functions.en: Return the item count in the layout, index or range.

functions.zh: 返回指定位置的布局项；不存在时返回空。
functions.en: Return the layout item at the given position, or null when absent.

functions.zh: 移除并返回指定位置的布局项，调用方负责布局项后续生命周期。
functions.en: Remove and return the layout item at the given position; the caller manages its subsequent lifetime.

functions.zh: 返回布局或控件的建议尺寸或最小建议尺寸，供父布局协商；auto height 启用时由内容固定高度。
functions.en: Return preferred or minimum size hints for parent layout negotiation; auto height fixes the actual height from content when enabled.

functions.zh: 返回布局或控件的建议尺寸或最小建议尺寸，供父布局协商；auto height 启用时由内容固定高度。
functions.en: Return preferred or minimum size hints for parent layout negotiation; auto height fixes the actual height from content when enabled.

functions.zh: 返回布局可以扩展的方向，供 Qt 布局系统协商空间。
functions.en: Return the directions in which the layout can expand for Qt layout negotiation.

functions.zh: 说明布局是否根据宽度计算高度，供 Qt 调用 heightForWidth。
functions.en: Report whether height depends on width so Qt can use heightForWidth.

functions.zh: 按给定宽度计算换行后的所需高度，包含布局自身间距和边距。
functions.en: Compute the required wrapped height for a width, including the layout's spacing and margins.

functions.zh: 设置布局几何对象或矩形。
functions.en: Set the layout geometry object or rectangle.

defaults.zh: 没有固定默认矩形；由父布局分配的可用矩形决定。
defaults.en: No fixed default rectangle; determined by the available geometry assigned by the parent layout.

functions.zh: 使指定布局或尺寸缓存失效；下次布局重新测量或计算。仅在内容尺寸确实变化时调用。
functions.en: Invalidate the indicated layout or size cache for subsequent measurement or calculation. Use only when content dimensions actually change.

functions.zh: 设置项目统一固定高度。
functions.en: Set the uniform fixed item height.

examples.zh: 少量真实标签控件按行换行并限制容器高度。chips 为已加入父布局的 WrapWidget，需包含 WrapLayout 和 QLabel；addWidget() 接管标签所有权。内边距由 WrapLayout 设置，总高度上限包含容器装饰。
examples.en: Wrap a small set of real label widgets and cap container height. chips is a WrapWidget already placed in its parent layout; include WrapLayout and QLabel. addWidget() takes label ownership. WrapLayout sets inner margins; the total height limit includes container decorations.

functions.zh: 返回项目统一固定高度。
functions.en: Return the uniform fixed item height.

functions.zh: 设置项目间距。
functions.en: Set the spacing between items.

examples.zh: 少量真实标签控件按行换行并限制容器高度。chips 为已加入父布局的 WrapWidget，需包含 WrapLayout 和 QLabel；addWidget() 接管标签所有权。内边距由 WrapLayout 设置，总高度上限包含容器装饰。
examples.en: Wrap a small set of real label widgets and cap container height. chips is a WrapWidget already placed in its parent layout; include WrapLayout and QLabel. addWidget() takes label ownership. WrapLayout sets inner margins; the total height limit includes container decorations.

functions.zh: 返回项目间距。
functions.en: Return the spacing between items.

functions.zh: 设置行间距。
functions.en: Set the spacing between rows.

examples.zh: 少量真实标签控件按行换行并限制容器高度。chips 为已加入父布局的 WrapWidget，需包含 WrapLayout 和 QLabel；addWidget() 接管标签所有权。内边距由 WrapLayout 设置，总高度上限包含容器装饰。
examples.en: Wrap a small set of real label widgets and cap container height. chips is a WrapWidget already placed in its parent layout; include WrapLayout and QLabel. addWidget() takes label ownership. WrapLayout sets inner margins; the total height limit includes container decorations.

functions.zh: 返回行间距。
functions.en: Return the spacing between rows.

functions.zh: 设置行内项目对齐方式。
functions.en: Set the item alignment within a line.

functions.zh: 返回行内项目对齐方式。
functions.en: Return the item alignment within a line.

functions.zh: 对应布局重新计算后发出，通知业务更新依赖排版的内容。
functions.en: Emitted when the corresponding layout changes so clients can update layout-dependent content.

functions.zh: 构造 WrapWidget；按此重载传入父对象、模型或布局参数。带 parent 的 QObject/QWidget 遵循 Qt 父子生命周期。
functions.en: Construct WrapWidget with the parent, model or layout arguments in this overload. QObject/QWidget parent arguments follow Qt parent-child lifetime rules.

functions.zh: 销毁 WrapWidget 并释放其拥有的资源；不在析构回调中继续使用该对象。
functions.en: Destroy WrapWidget and release its owned resources; do not keep using the object during destruction callbacks.

functions.zh: 返回真实控件换行布局对象。
functions.en: Return the wrapping layout for real widgets.

examples.zh: 少量真实标签控件按行换行并限制容器高度。chips 为已加入父布局的 WrapWidget，需包含 WrapLayout 和 QLabel；addWidget() 接管标签所有权。内边距由 WrapLayout 设置，总高度上限包含容器装饰。
examples.en: Wrap a small set of real label widgets and cap container height. chips is a WrapWidget already placed in its parent layout; include WrapLayout and QLabel. addWidget() takes label ownership. WrapLayout sets inner margins; the total height limit includes container decorations.

functions.zh: 把控件加入指定位置；WrapLayout/WrapWidget 使用真实控件，不进行虚拟化回收。
functions.en: Add a widget at the requested position. WrapLayout/WrapWidget manage real widgets without virtualized recycling.

notes.zh: 控件所有权转移给内部内容宿主。takeWidget 会隐藏并解除父子关系，把所有权交还调用方；clear 会直接删除全部子控件。
notes.en: Widget ownership transfers to the internal content host. takeWidget hides and detaches a widget, returning ownership to the caller; clear deletes all contained widgets.

functions.zh: 把控件加入指定位置；WrapLayout/WrapWidget 使用真实控件，不进行虚拟化回收。
functions.en: Add a widget at the requested position. WrapLayout/WrapWidget manage real widgets without virtualized recycling.

notes.zh: 控件所有权转移给内部内容宿主。takeWidget 会隐藏并解除父子关系，把所有权交还调用方；clear 会直接删除全部子控件。
notes.en: Widget ownership transfers to the internal content host. takeWidget hides and detaches a widget, returning ownership to the caller; clear deletes all contained widgets.

functions.zh: 移出指定控件并返回它，调用方负责后续处理。
functions.en: Remove and return the specified widget for the caller to manage.

functions.zh: 删除 WrapWidget 中全部控件及布局项。
functions.en: Delete every widget and layout item contained in WrapWidget.

functions.zh: 设置按内容固定视图高度的开关。
functions.en: Set the content-based fixed view height setting.

notes.zh: 虚拟视图默认关闭，WrapWidget 默认开启。启用后按内容设置固定高度，父布局不再把它压缩；上限为 0 时不限高。高度包含边距、间距、表头和实际边框等占位。使用 setAutoHeightMaximumHeight 控制上限，不要同时用 QWidget 高度约束干预；关闭后恢复原约束。内部无滚动范围时，滚轮交给外层。
notes.en: Disabled by default on virtual views and enabled on WrapWidget. When enabled, content sets a fixed height that the parent layout cannot compress; a maximum of 0 is unlimited. The height includes margins, gaps, headers and occupied frame space. Use setAutoHeightMaximumHeight rather than competing QWidget height constraints; disabling restores prior constraints. Wheel input propagates outward when there is no internal scroll range.

examples.zh: 少量真实标签控件按行换行并限制容器高度。chips 为已加入父布局的 WrapWidget，需包含 WrapLayout 和 QLabel；addWidget() 接管标签所有权。内边距由 WrapLayout 设置，总高度上限包含容器装饰。
examples.en: Wrap a small set of real label widgets and cap container height. chips is a WrapWidget already placed in its parent layout; include WrapLayout and QLabel. addWidget() takes label ownership. WrapLayout sets inner margins; the total height limit includes container decorations.
